title: Arlo Essential Solar Security Camera Makes Solar-Powered Security Easy
summary: Eliminate battery anxiety and get ‘round-the-clock security with the Arlo Essential Solar Security Camera’s built-in solar panel.
body_markdown:
Wireless security cameras offer incredible flexibility. Thanks to their built-in rechargeable batteries, you can install them anywhere on your property, whether that’s in the garage, next to the shed, overlooking the pool, or watching over your front yard. As long as your cameras can reach your home network’s Wi-Fi signal, you can get video security coverage.


The flexibility of these batteries comes at a cost: Eventually, they will need to be recharged. While many rechargeable batteries can last for several months on a single charge, battery management becomes another thing you need to juggle along with the rest of the household maintenance tasks you’re worrying about.


Enter the Arlo Essential Solar Security Camera: An all-in-one solution that combines Arlo’s tried and tested solar panel technology with its award-winning security cameras. No more bulky add-ons, no more cable management, and no more battery anxiety. Just seamless, comprehensive, long-lasting coverage from a brand you can trust.
